notes: Five routes, none with waypoints or a distinguishing name in any recording; Peakbagger match is East Peak (summit 5,394 ft). Recordings cluster at the Mirror Lake trailhead (47.3422,-121.4224) and at the PCT/Mount Catherine trailhead (47.3727,-121.4463); the Mirror Lake boot-path loop is the most common line and probably corresponds to the Southeast Spur or Northwest Ridge, but that needs an owner call. Peakbagger also shows a higher west peak (about 1,700 m) that many parties tag together with the East Peak.
